item.title: Supreme Court Strikes Down Trump’s Global Tariffs in 6–3 Ruling
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court struck down on Friday President Donald Trump's sweeping tariffs that he pursued under a law meant for use in national emergencies, rejecting one of his most contentious assertions of his authority in a ruling with major implications for the global economy.

item.title: Australian Warship Transits Taiwan Strait, Tracked By China’s Navy
item.description: Australian frigate HMAS Toowoomba transited the Taiwan Strait as part of an Indo-Pacific deployment, prompting tracking by China's PLA Navy. Beijing claims the strategic waterway as territorial waters despite international law recognizing it as an international passage.

item.title: US Revokes Visas For Chile Officials Over China Cable Plan
item.description: The US State Department revoked visas for Chile's Transport Minister and two other officials over a proposed undersea telecommunications cable linking Chile to Hong Kong, forcing the South American nation to navigate between its top trading partner China and strategic ally Washington.

item.title: Fin Whale Ship Strikes Surge In Chilean Waters
item.description: Fin whales feeding in Chile's northern bays face escalating threats from ship collisions and fishing nets, making the region a global hotspot for whale strandings. Marine experts warn the deaths threaten climate-critical species.
